name: Mente Clara Core
author: Wilder Espinoza

sections.description:
Mente Clara Core is the structured-content layer of the Mente Clara project maintained by Wilder Espinoza at Lideratec Academy. It keeps structured content independent from the active theme.

  • Services, specialists, plans, testimonials, and frequently asked questions.
  • Specialist taxonomy and configurable metadata.
  • Contact and newsletter forms with nonces, validation, rate limiting, and honeypot protection.
  • Private inquiry records and configurable retention.
  • WordPress privacy exporter and eraser integrations.
  • Optional demonstration content importer triggered only by an administrator.
  • No tracking and no external API calls.

The plugin can be used with Mente Clara or with another compatible WordPress theme.

Privacy

Depending on enabled forms, this plugin may store names, email addresses, phone numbers, consent timestamps, and message content as private WordPress content. Administrators can configure retention and use WordPress privacy export and erase tools. The plugin does not store clinical histories or payment card data and does not transmit information to an external service by itself.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP under Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate Mente Clara Core.
  3. Open the Mente Clara menu to configure content and privacy settings.
  4. Use Mente Clara > Demo Content only when you explicitly want sample content.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin require the Mente Clara theme?

No. The structured content remains available when the active theme changes.

Does it send data to an external service?

No. The plugin does not include analytics, tracking, or external API requests.

Does the demo importer overwrite content?

It only runs after an administrator confirms the action. Existing items with the same title are preserved.
sections.changelog:
1.5.6

  • Replaced email meta-value lookup queries with a private WordPress taxonomy index for privacy exports, erasure requests, and newsletter duplicate checks.
  • Finished prefixing uninstall-scope variables with the plugin-specific wesp_mcc_ prefix.
  • No external services or custom database tables are introduced by this change.

1.5.3

  • Hardened global identifiers and stored-data prefixes with the unique wesp_mcc_ prefix.
  • Rechecked nonce and capability protections for administrative write actions.
  • Moved the top-level administration menu to the normal plugin area by removing the forced high-priority position.
  • Aligned the author URI with the project domain used for ownership verification.

1.5.2

  • Addressed WordPress.org Plugin Check findings for prefixing, translator comments, nonce analysis, input sanitization, and automatic translation loading.
  • Updated the readme short description to standard English.

1.5.1

  • Prepared WordPress.org metadata using contributor account wespinozab.
  • Updated plugin and author URLs, tested version, privacy documentation, and copyright information.
  • Clarified that demo content requires explicit administrator action.

1.5.0

  • Improved interoperability across the Mente Clara ecosystem.
  • Kept structured content independent from premium licensing.

1.4.0

  • Consolidated integration with portal, booking, commerce, and SEO extensions.
